scope: 从已取得导出中选取可见用户/助手消息；不含内部推理、工具日志或授权码。不声称完整平台记录；保留来源顺序，文件之间可能重叠。子代理初始指令未必由导出接口返回；不能据助手回复条数推定实现调用次数。

- Finding floor: 198,124 bytes ÷ 1,000 = 198.124 kB; N = min(floor(√198.124 + 1), 10) = min(15, 10) = **10**.

- [booking.js:150](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/booking.js:150) clears `unknown` whenever a retry returns a recognized error. A lost successful response followed by `STORE_BUSY`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`, or `AUTH_REQUIRED` still leaves the original outcome unresolved. Reproducing lost response → 500 changes the button to “确认预约” and removes the uncertainty warning. Preserve uncertainty about the original submission until its result is established.

- [booking.js:27](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/booking.js:27) displays the unresolved-original warning only for the first material keystroke. The next keystroke replaces it with the ordinary new-intent message because `unknown` has already been cleared. Keep the unresolved previous intent’s warning independently of the draft currently being edited.

- [booking.js:178](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/booking.js:178) overwrites a previously confirmed success when a later confirmation loses its response. The user then sees “原预约可能已成功” and loses the displayed booking ID, despite creation already being confirmed. Retain the last confirmed booking and distinguish an unsuccessful status refresh from an unknown initial creation.

- [booking.js:173](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/booking.js:173) validates response shape but never checks that the booking matches the submitted intent. A response with room `999`, a different title, and a different attendee count is accepted as “已确认原预约” in the existing harness. Compare the immutable six fields with the normalized request, and retain/check the original ID after the first confirmed success.

- [booking.js:175](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/booking.js:175) ignores the replay response’s current room metadata. The displayed room/location remain the selection snapshot even though the backend deliberately returns renamed rooms and updated locations. Refresh the displayed booking facts from the confirmed DTO so the confirmation does not present stale location information.

- [booking.js:64](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/booking.js:64) does not enforce several domain constraints despite treating malformed success responses as unconfirmed: empty or overlong purposes, NUL-containing titles, and out-of-range capacities pass its checks. Extend response validation and its malformed-response tests to cover the constraints represented by `BookingFull`.

- [verify_auth_browser.cjs:320](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_auth_browser.cjs:320) tests only response loss after a successful commit. Add the complementary case where the first request never reaches the server: an explicit retry must retain the key, accept **201**, and leave exactly one booking and audit event. This distinguishes “retry confirms an existing booking” from “retry performs the first successful creation.”

- [verify_replay_intent_http.py:56](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_replay_intent_http.py:56) exercises concurrent identical payloads, while payload mismatch is tested only sequentially. Add concurrent requests sharing a user/key but carrying two different valid payloads; assert one winning payload, matching replays, `IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH` for the other payload, and one immutable stored result.

- [verify_auth_browser.py:160](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_auth_browser.py:160) writes the browser report only after success. Re-running `--replay` into an existing evidence directory and failing leaves the previous successful report alongside partially replaced screenshots/network files. Write an initial incomplete manifest with a run ID and update it on failure, as the new HTTP verifier already does.

- [verify_replay_intent_http.py:130](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_replay_intent_http.py:130) fingerprints the application and replay script but omits `verify_create_booking_http.py`, which supplies the server, injected fault writer, clock, and storage oracle. Changes to that dependency can alter what was verified without changing the recorded verifier hashes. Include the directly imported verification helpers and fixture sources in the evidence fingerprints.
